tasks.title: Conversation #85
tasks.transcript:
Man: Are you still planning to go to the exercise class this evening?
Woman: Yes, I am, but I realized my old mat is completely worn out. I'll need to pick up a new one before I go.
Man: There's a sporting goods store just a few blocks from the studio.
Woman: Perfect. I'll stop by on my way, hopefully they have a decent selection.
Man: Well, if not, the studio has plenty you can borrow. That's what I always do. See you there.

questions.stem: What does the woman want to do before an exercise class?
questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：女士在上健身课之前想做什么？ 定位原文： Woman: ... I realized my old mat is completely worn out. I'll need to pick up a new one before I go. 选项分析： A. Meet an exercise instructor 见健身教练。对话中没有提到要见教练，所以A选项错误。 B. Get a new exercise mat 买个新的健身垫。女士明确说她的旧垫子已经坏了，需要在上课前买个新的，所以B选项正确。 C. Reserve a spot in class 预订课程名额。对话中没有提到预订名额，所以C选项错误。 D. Buy some snacks 买些零食。对话中没有提到零食，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the man?

options.A: He does not have an exercise mat.
options.B: He works at a sporting goods store.
options.C: He will give the woman a ride to the studio.
options.D: He will not attend the exercise class tonight.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：关于男士可以推断出什么？ 定位原文： Man: Well, if not, the studio has plenty you can borrow. That's what I always do. 选项分析： A. He does not have an exercise mat. 他没有健身垫。男士说“我一直都是这样做的”，意思是自己上课时也经常借用工作室的垫子，可以推断出他没有自己的垫子，所以A选项正确。 B. He works at a sporting goods store. 他在体育用品店工作。男士只是提到附近有一家体育用品店，并没有说他在那里工作，所以B选项错误。 C. He will give the woman a ride to the studio. 他会顺路送女士去工作室。对话中没有提到开车或接送，所以C选项错误。 D. He will not attend the exercise class tonight. 他今晚不去上健身课。男士最后说“See you there”，说明他也会去上课，所以D选项错误。
